questions.stem: Which of the following bacteria is responsible for UTI in a diabetic patient, and urine culture showing gram-positive, spectacle shape, non-motile, non-sporing, survives in the presence of 6.5% NaCl and exhibits resistance to 40% bile and shows a positive PYR test?
